scope: Root Python sources and project experiment sources/plans/summaries; excluded vendor, .venv, tabicl-v2 dependency cache. Not a mathematical proof against every possible reparameterization.

closest.wavelet_scattering_096.py: Kymatio J6 L8 order2 modulus cascade and global averaging; no complex phase doubling.
closest.native_texture_features.py: LoG squared-energy tile correlation and Fourier POWER angular harmonics; neither is wavelet coefficient phase harmonics.
closest.threepoint_features_108.py: Centered rawpixel line/corner products at fixedlags, D4 moments; thirdorder phase coupling related but amplitude cubed, different from WPH degree2.
closest.binary_threepoint_features_130.py: Quantilebinary centered 2/3point correlations, not complex wavelet phase alignment.
closest.cnn_texture_fusion.py: Learned feature covariance, no analytic crossscale H2.
closest.patch_phase_104.py: DINO patch-grid origin shift, not complex phase.
closest.phase_features.py: Intensity/material phase mixture proxies, not complex phase.

new_hypothesis: Adjacent-scale phase-aligned coefficient covariance can distinguish phase relationships with equal amplitudes. Whether this complements hardness predictors is unknown; not guaranteed independent of all existing nonlinear embeddings or higher-order statistics.
source_limit: Texture/random process synthesis papers, not hardness prediction evidence. Compact custom filterbank subset, not full paper reproduction.
